name: identify-phone-utils
title: Phone Number Utils
description: Identify the country of a phone number from its prefix, format or strip formatting — no API needed.
author: degouville

commands.name: identify-phone-country
commands.title: Identify Phone Country
commands.description: Type or paste a phone number to instantly identify its country of origin.

commands.name: format-in-us-format
commands.title: Format as US Number
commands.description: Format a phone number from clipboard or selection as (XXX) XXX-XXXX.

commands.name: remove-formatting
commands.title: Remove Formatting
commands.description: Strip all formatting from a phone number in clipboard or selection.

commands.name: format-phone-number
commands.title: Format Phone Number
commands.description: Format a phone number in multiple formats: E.164, US, RFC 3966, and digits only.

commands.name: extract-phone-numbers
commands.title: Extract Phone Numbers
commands.description: Extract all phone numbers from selected text or clipboard, with country identification.

commands.name: lookup-country-code
commands.title: Look Up Country Code
commands.description: Search all countries by name or dial code to find the international dialing prefix.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
